turns.text: got 202 from link carecontext api, does that mean the record is linked?

must_contain: The 202 on the link call is only receipt, not the outcome of linking.
The care context is linked only when a callback reaches /api/v3/link/on_carecontext with status Successfully Linked care context and a requestId equal to the REQUEST-ID of your link call.
notes: A first-day developer reads 202 as success. Source lines: catalogue/hiecm/callbacks/m2-on-carecontext-result.md, 'Read `status` for the outcome: `Successfully Linked care context`'; 'Treat the care context as linked only when this callback says so'; 'A callback with `status` of `Successfully Linked care context` and a `requestId` equal to your stored `REQUEST-ID`'. The path /api/v3/link/on_carecontext is in the same atom's operation m2_post_v3_link_on_carecontext and verbatim in catalogue/hiecm/endpoints/m2-hip-link-care-context.md, 'A callback on `/api/v3/link/on_carecontext` with `status` of `Successfully Linked care context`. The 202 on this call is not the outcome.' Review: added hiecm.endpoint.m2-hip-link-care-context, which carries 'The 202 on this call is not the outcome' and the on_carecontext path; the callback atom carries neither.
